desc: Trix Cereal is a delicious breakfast cereal for the entire family to enjoy. With No High Fructose Corn Syrup, you can enjoy Trix with milk or by itself for a school snack.
features:
- Bright, fun fruit-flavored corn puff shapes kids love  

- Made with whole-grain corn; at least 14 g whole grain per serving :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}  

- Fortified with 12 vitamins & minerals including B vitamins, vitamin D, iron, zinc :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}  

- Free of trans fat and cholesterol  

- OU Kosher certified  

- Vibrant, colorful breakfast treat
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn; Sugar; Rice Flour; Corn Syrup; Canola and/or Sunflower Oil; Salt; Trisodium Phosphate; Natural and Artificial Flavor; Red 40, Yellow 6, Blue 1 (and other colors); Citric Acid; Malic Acid; Rosemary Extract; Calcium Carbonate; Tricalcium Phosphate; Vitamin C; Iron; Zinc; Niacinamide; Vitamin B6; Thiamin Mononitrate; Vitamin A Palmitate; Riboflavin; Folic Acid; Vitamin B12; Vitamin D3.
